scope: Fixed before inference; rankings within these lists are diagnostic similarities, not calibrated probabilities or artistic intent.

people: a portrait photograph of a person
natural_landscape: a photograph of mountains, trees, water or countryside
indoor_room: a photograph of a room inside a building
a photograph of an indoor living room or kitchen
urban_architecture: a photograph of buildings or a city street
an architectural photograph of a building
animal_pet: a photograph of a pet dog or cat
object_still_life: a close-up photograph of an object
a still life photograph of everyday objects
document_graphic: an image of a document, screenshot or graphic
a photograph of a printed page

daylight: a photograph taken outdoors in daylight
a photograph taken outdoors on a sunny day
overcast: a photograph taken outdoors under an overcast sky
a photograph taken outdoors on a cloudy day
sunset_sunrise: a photograph of a sunset or sunrise
a photograph of a warm sky at dusk or dawn
night: a photograph taken outdoors at night
a photograph of a night scene after dark
indoor_artificial: a photograph taken indoors under artificial lighting
a photograph of an interior lit by lamps
indoor_natural: a photograph taken indoors in natural window light
a photograph of an interior lit by daylight
underexposed_daylight: an underexposed photograph taken during the daytime
a daytime photograph that is much too dark
